before: A host placing a floating menu at the selection had to measure the painted DOM: the facade exposed no selection geometry.
after: Editor.getSelectionRects() answers where the selection is on screen, in client coordinates, from layout: one rectangle per line of a range, or a zero-width one at a collapsed caret (in its slot at a tagged edge), the retained selection when pinned.
reason: A read of layout geometry; nothing reaches the document, an operation or shared updates.
